data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Farhana' which means 'bright' or 'shining one'. In Islamic history, Ferhana is associated with the pure and radiant light of Allah and the prophets. The name Ferhana carries the meaning “Bright, shining one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ferhana usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ferhana total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
